title: 反射系数与驻波比：负载不匹配会怎样
statement: 75 Ω 无损耗同轴电缆长 l = 3.25 m，相速 v = 2×10⁸ m/s，工作频率 100 MHz。信号源 U̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），内阻 R_s = 75 Ω；终端负载 Z_L = (25 − j50) Ω。
反射系数定义为同一点反射波电压与入射波电压之比 Γ = U̇⁻/U̇⁺；x′ 从终端量起，指向始端。

questions.ask: 距终端 x′ = 0.25 m 处反射系数 Γ(x′) 的辐角 = ?
始端入射波电压的有效值 |U̇_1⁺| = ?
questions.explain: 源内阻等于 Z_c，向线上发出的入射波与负载无关：U̇_1⁺ = U̇_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c) = 5 V。

questions.ask: |Γ(x′)| 沿这条无损耗线怎样变化？
choiceExplain: 那是有损耗线（e^{−2αx′}）。这里 α = 0。
波节处 Γ 的辐角为 180°，模仍是 |Γ_2|。
questions.explain: 无损耗线上 Γ(x′) = Γ_2·e^{−j2βx′}，只转相位、模不变；有损耗时才有 e^{−2αx′} 的衰减。

hints: 先算终端：Γ_2 只由 Z_L 和 Z_c 决定，与电源、线长无关。
沿线向电源方向移动 x′，入射波相位超前 βx′、反射波滞后 βx′，所以 Γ(x′) = Γ_2·e^{−j2βx′}。
入射波由电源和输入端决定：R_s = Z_c 时始端没有二次反射，U̇_1⁺ = U̇_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c)。
solution: **4. 入射波。** R_s = Z_c：U̇_1⁺ = 10 × 75/150 = **5 V**。反射波到达始端被内阻全部吸收（Γ_1 = 0），所以不会再反射回来。

en.title: Reflection coefficient and VSWR: what a mismatched load does
statement: A 75 Ω lossless coaxial cable is l = 3.25 m long, with phase velocity v = 2×10⁸ m/s, at 100 MHz. The source is U̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms) with internal resistance R_s = 75 Ω; the load is Z_L = (25 − j50) Ω.
The reflection coefficient is the ratio of the reflected to the incident voltage wave at the same point, Γ = U̇⁻/U̇⁺; x′ is measured from the end towards the start.

questions.ask: Magnitude of the reflection coefficient at the end |Γ_2| = ?
Angle of the reflection coefficient Γ(x′) at x′ = 0.25 m from the end = ?
rms value of the incident voltage wave at the start |U̇_1⁺| = ?
questions.explain: With the source resistance equal to Z_c the incident wave it launches does not depend on the load: U̇_1⁺ = U̇_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c) = 5 V.

questions.ask: How does |Γ(x′)| change along this lossless line?
choices: It gets smaller away from the load
It is zero at the voltage minima
questions.explain: On a lossless line Γ(x′) = Γ_2·e^{−j2βx′}: only the angle turns, the magnitude stays; the factor e^{−2αx′} appears only with losses.
choiceExplain: That happens on a lossy line (e^{−2αx′}); here α = 0.
At a voltage minimum the angle of Γ is 180°, its magnitude is still |Γ_2|.

hints: Start at the end: Γ_2 depends only on Z_L and Z_c, not on the source or the length.
Moving x′ towards the source the incident wave leads by βx′ and the reflected wave lags by βx′, so Γ(x′) = Γ_2·e^{−j2βx′}.
The incident wave is set by the source and the input: with R_s = Z_c nothing is re-reflected at the start, U̇_1⁺ = U̇_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c).
solution: **1. Reflection coefficient at the end.** Γ_2 = (Z_L − Z_c)/(Z_L + Z_c) = (−50 − j50)/(100 − j50) = **0.632∠−108.4°**.
**4. Incident wave.** R_s = Z_c: U̇_1⁺ = 10 × 75/150 = **5 V**. The reflected wave is absorbed by the source resistance when it reaches the start (Γ_1 = 0), so nothing comes back.
